title: 헌법재판소 참고인 등 비용지급에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 헌법재판소 참고인 등 비용지급에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Research Expenses)
(1) Where a person providing information submits a written opinion concerning specialized knowledge at the request of the Constitutional Court, or appears at oral argument and makes a statement, research expenses may be paid within budgetary limits. <Amended on June 19, 2019; and April 30, 2026.>
(2) Where a person providing an expert opinion who has been requested to appear on a date for investigation conducted by a Constitutional Court research officer appears on that date and makes a statement, or submits a written opinion concerning specialized knowledge, research expenses may be paid within budgetary limits. <Newly Inserted on April 30, 2026.>
